definitions.gloss: various places; each place; multiple locations
definitions.explanation: Refers to multiple different places or locations. Used when describing things that exist or happen at several locations.

examples.japanese: {各所|かくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{案内|あんない}{板|ばん}→案内板：22318_annaiban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are information boards at various places.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各所|かくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: Events are held at various places throughout the city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{県内|けんない}→県内：27823_kennai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各所|かくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冠水|かんすい}→冠水：20916_kansui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, roads were flooded at various locations throughout the prefecture.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word often used in news, announcements, and official descriptions. Commonly preceded by a scope word like ⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧ (within the city) or ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧ (within the country) to specify where.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各所|かくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to deploy at various locations)
- {各所|かくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧ (can be seen at various places)
- ⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧{各所|かくしょ} (various places in the city)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧: various regions — similar but suggests broader, more geographically spread-out areas
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧: here and there — casual, everyday equivalent
